prompt: Which prints a person's name and age on one line, formatted as 'Alice is 30 years old.'?
choices: System.out.printf("%s is %d years old.%n", name, age);
explanation: %s substitutes the String (name), %d substitutes the int (age), %n adds a newline. Option A is missing spaces around 'is'. Option C: println/print take one argument. Option D: format needs a format string with specifiers.
